findings.description: The old code substituted an empty description when an argument had no help text. The new code passes Argument.get_help_record output directly to write_dl, which can contain None as the description.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command has one positional argument with help and another without help, so the Positional arguments section is written. Mechanism: the undocumented argument's record is (metavar, None) because Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, and write_dl receives None as the second column. Impact: help rendering either crashes on None or prints a wrong description, which the removed fallback was there to prevent.
